name: Potassium chloride
what_it_is: A salt much like ordinary table salt, but carrying potassium instead of sodium.
why_its_added: Gives a salty taste while putting less sodium into the food.

india.note: Permitted at GMP level - used as needed, no fixed numeric cap in the categories found.

eu.note: Re‐evaluation of hydrochloric acid -E 507-, potassium chloride -E 508-, calcium chloride -E 509- and magnesium chloride -E 511- as food additives

usa.note: Generally Recognised As Safe (GRAS) for direct addition to food (21 CFR 184.1622)

safe_daily_limit.no_number_means: EFSA has not set a number for this one. That can mean it is considered safe enough not to need a limit, or that the evidence was not sufficient to set one. The opinion itself says which.

means: No single-serving limit has been found for this substance. That is not the same as there being no risk from one large serving - it means nobody has published a number.

people_reports.rule: Reports are shown as reports. We count them. We never turn them into a health claim, and we never let them change the sourced facts above.
